primary_claim: ChatGPT with o3 + web search outperformed all other LLMs and commercial deep-research tools on Deep Research Bench (DRB) by a comfortable margin, while still clearly worse than a skilled human.
limitations_stated: Claude web + Claude Research were not able to read PDFs, which likely hurt their scores
Results between DRB-250506 (paper) and the continuously updated DRB cannot be compared directly since tasks and agent architecture were updated
Commercial tools were run only once per task and on a smaller set of 66 task instances since some tasks cannot be recreated with commercial products
Hallucinations have not much decreased with recent model releases, and DeepSeek R1 is especially prone to them
LLMs still make basic reasoning/inference errors, are gullible toward unreliable sources, and often stop at minimal-effort solutions
quote: We find that ChatGPT with o3 + web search enabled outperformed all other approaches we tested, by a comfortable margin.
